target.title: fix(cron): use truncateUtf16Safe for diagnostic entry and summary truncation
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Two `.slice(0, N-1)` truncation sites in cron run-diagnostics may cut UTF-16 surrogate pairs in half when the diagnostic entry or summary contains multi-byte characters such as emoji.

## Changes

- `src/cron/run-diagnostics.ts`: replace `redacted.slice(0, MAX_ENTRY_CHARS - 1)` and `normalized.slice(0, MAX_SUMMARY_CHARS - 1)` with `truncateUtf16Safe`.

Label: bugfix | merge-risk: 🟢 minimal
